description: Model: L2-regularized logistic regression trained only on training mice with group-aware cross-validation and per-mouse equalization. Features include sensory evidence (right/left contrasts), experimenter block prior (and its logit), their interactions, and history terms from the last five choices/feedbacks plus reinforcement-like products and recency-weighted aggregates. All transforms are fitted on training data only; no identifiers or ordering are used. Hyperparameter C is chosen by 5-fold GroupKFold on mouse IDs, optimizing the primary metric: mean negative log-likelihood averaged per validation mouse. Fitting uses sample weights that make each training mouse contribute equally. Final probabilities on test are clipped to [1e-6, 1-1e-6], representing P(turn CW = source choice +1) per test row.
